children.name: The adjustable ergonomic wrist rest, which mounts to the upper front bar of the ScienceDeskT frame and is designed to provide the optimum height and angle for adjusting nanopositioning stages, allows operators to perform delicate instrument adjustments with higher accuracy and lower fatigue.
